hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Systematix Group as a promoter-led, diversified financial services firm established in 1985 by Mr. CP Khandelwal, operating four verticals (Investment Banking, Equity Brokerage, Private Wealth, Asset Management) and currently investing ahead of revenue to build out Private Wealth and a new AIF/PMS asset-management franchise.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Self-described as "a diversified financial services firm established in 1985 by Mr. CP Khandelwal, backed by 40 years of industry experience with a team of more than 300+ diverse professionals"; listed on NSE & BSE with Mcap of "₹799 Cr / $92 M (as on 7th August 2026)".
- Investment Banking is branded "INDIA's Fastest Growing Investment Bank", delivered by a "Strong 30+ member team" offering fund raising, M&A, structured finance and ECM under one umbrella.
- Capital-markets track record cited on a cumulative basis (figures "on basis of transactions executed in last 6 years (upto June'26)"): IB Transactions Executed/Value ₹36,300 Cr+/$4.2B, of which QIPs ₹17,000 Cr, IPOs ₹3,700 Cr, Block Deals ~₹5,642 Cr, PE & M&A ₹4,139 Cr+, Pre-IPO ₹1,300 Cr, DRHP Filings ₹2,250 Cr.
- Institutional franchise: empanelled with 200+ institutional investors, research coverage of ~317 stocks (Large/Mid/Small Caps) spread across 20+ sectors, with "Relationship with all Marquee Fund Houses".
- Group Strengths slide lists six qualitative moats: extensive industry experience, end-to-end solutions under a single umbrella, wide network of corporate relationships, experienced management & team, comprehensive product offerings and access to a large pool of global relationships.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Five-year benchmarking (INR Crores, FY21 → FY26): Revenue from Operation 55 → 146, PAT 1 → 14, Net Worth 77 → 314, ROE 2% → 4%. The deck's text states the growth as "Revenue at a CAGR of 21.60%, Profits at a CAGR of 69.00%, Networth at a CAGR of 32.30%, and Grown its RoE to 4%", while the same chart also carries the rounded labels 22% / 69% / 32%.
- Balance-sheet capital is being committed to the firm's own funds — a ₹10 Cr sponsor commitment into the ₹1,000 Cr India Equity Opportunities Fund — alongside the operating investment in Private Wealth infrastructure.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Corporate access] Systematix Promoters & Founders Forum (June 2026) convened 30 corporates, 200+ clients, 150+ funds and drew 1200+ meeting requests; named participating companies include BSE, National Aluminium, Mahanagar Gas, Capri Global Capital, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, 360 ONE WAM, Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, Gulf Oil Lubricants, Hindustan Foods, Shaily Engineering Plastics, Stylam Industries, Technocraft Industries, Jain Resource Recycling, Viyash Scientific and Indiabulls.
- [Leadership build-out] Mr. Ratnadeep Acharyya joined as Managing Director & CEO - IB with 24+ years across SBI Capital Markets, JM Financial, BNP Paribas, ICICI Securities and ICICI Bank Treasury, previously on the IB leadership team and Executive Committee at SBICAPS; Private Wealth is run by two Joint Managing Director & CEOs (Mr. Partha Sengupta and Mr. Bhaskar Hazra).
- [Extraction caveat — Q1 FY27 IB highlights] The Investment Banking highlights slide lists activity labels (DRHP Filed, Rights Issue, BSE Listing, Block Deals) alongside the values INR 168 Cr, INR 64 Cr, INR 53 Cr and INR 1,000 Cr, but the label-to-value binding is lost in the text extract, so no pairing is asserted here.
